body:
### JamatoP, along with high ranking null soldiers use this totem tp glitch to escape any bad situations they get in.

Basically, as soon as their totem pops, their stasis chamber gets pulled and they teleport away to a safe location!

## JomatoP, along with high ranking null soldiers use this totem tp glitch to escape any bad situations they get in.

Basically, as soon as their totem pops, their stasis chamber gets pulled and they teleport away to a safe location!


### How to set it up?
- open the datapack
- click on data -> totemtp -> functions
- open both files
- replace "<pos>" with _coordinates of the stasis trapdoor_
- enable the datapack
- run /forceload _coordinates of the trapdoor_

_For example: <pos> will be 123 40 321_

- type this to get the custom totem (it wont work with normal totem of undying)
```
/function totemtp:get_totem
```

_if you are wondering why you can't see the forceload command in the get_totem.mcfunction, its because it was bugging the function and it was making it not work in game._

### Should you change it?

NO, DO NOT CHANGE ANYTHING OTHER THAN <pos> IN THE DATAPACK.


### If you change anything else and the datapack stops working,
### 
### I am NOT RESPONSIBLE
